name: Schitt's Creek
description: Formerly filthy rich video store magnate Johnny Rose, his soap star wife Moira, and their two kids, über-hipster son David and socialite daughter Alexis, suddenly find themselves broke and forced to live in Schitt's Creek, a small depressing town they once bought as a joke.

videos.title: Wake Up With The Schitt's: Spilling the Beans on the Good News
videos.overview: Mayor Roland and his wife Jocelyn spill the beans on the good news, 'Wake Up With The Schitt's' is now three minutes instead of just one. Roland tells a gripping story about hogs while the couple debates the popularity of Jocelyn's “famous” Gouda Balls recipe.

videos.title: Wake Up With The Schitt's: Win a Call from the Mayor
videos.overview: Roland and Jocelyn introduce a brand new segment: Win A Call From The Mayor. They pick a Schitt's Creek resident's name randomly and the lucky constituent gets a call from the Mayor himself! Not to spoil anything, but things get candid! Also, Jocelyn complains about loud birds.

videos.title: Wake Up With The Schitt's: With Special Guest Stevie Budd
videos.overview: Roland and Jocelyn welcome a very special guest, the enigmatic front desk vixen at the motel, Stevie Budd. Roland asks her the question we've all wanted to ask: just what makes Stevie Budd tick? And did someone say, “makeover”?

videos.title: Wake Up With The Schitt's: Cheese Sculptures
videos.overview: Jocelyn gives viewers a first hand account of last weekend's exciting Crafts Fair where she won first prize for her cheese sculpture, “Cheddar Squirrel Right Before Dawn.” She then shows the audience just how easy it is to sculpt cheese with a live demonstration not to be missed!

videos.title: Wake Up With The Schitt's: Swap Shop
videos.overview: The Mayor and his wife introduce a thrilling new segment on the show called “Swap Shop,” which lets viewers call in for a chance to swap one specific item for another specific item. You'll never guess who calls in!

videos.title: Wake Up With The Schitt's: Holiday Dish
videos.overview: Jocelyn prepares her delicious but simple holiday dish: Ancho-Rubbed Turkey Tetrazzini with a side of Mashed Potato Folly. Roland is her sous chef but gets a little handsy with the mayonnaise, if you know what we mean!

videos.title: Wake Up With The Schitt's: With Special Guest Twyla Sands
videos.overview: Jocelyn is still on cloud nine after the glorious opening gala for her new gardening book. Roland tells a harrowing story about a near death experience, which can be found in HIS new book, Roland Schitt's Past Life Experiences. They welcome special guest and head waitress at Cafe Tropical, Twyla, who justifiably shows off her impressive doll collection.

videos.title: Wake Up With The Schitt's: With Special Guest Alexis Rose
videos.overview: Roland and Jocelyn reveal the bad news: Wake Up With the Schitt's has been cancelled and will be replaced by a live traffic feed of Main Street. But the two try to make the best of what looks to be their final episode.

videos.title: Merry Christmas, Johnny Rose
videos.overview: It's Christmas Eve and Johnny wants to celebrate with an old-fashioned Rose Christmas Party but the rest of the family has trouble getting into the Christmas spirit.

videos.title: Best Wishes, Warmest Regards: A Schitt’s Creek Farewell
videos.overview:
A farewell from the crew.

Behind-the-scenes documentary

videos.title: Schitt's Creek feat. Mariah Carey | Dear Class Of 2020
videos.overview: Dear Class of 2020 is a virtual commencement celebration bringing together inspirational leaders and artists to celebrate graduates, their families, and their communities.

videos.title: Schitt’s Creek Cast Q&A w/ Jennifer Garner
videos.overview: The cast of “Schitts Creek” sits down for a live, unfiltered Q&A with Jennifer Garner to discuss the final season of the iconic comedy series.

videos.title: Inside Schitt's Creek: Welcome to Town
videos.overview: Welcome to Schitt's Creek. If you're not familiar with the town, this tourism video highlights the best they have to offer. Please visit.

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Jocelyn’s House Tour
videos.overview: Post dinner party, Jocelyn gives us a tour of her personal oasis, the Schitt house, showing off some of her most prized possessions.

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: The Suggestion Box
videos.overview: David creates a “suggestion box" for Stevie with some ideas on how to improve the motel.

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Mom’s Wigs
videos.overview: David and Alexis were never allowed near Moira's wigs growing up, but living in Schitt's Creek has brought everything closer... physically.

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Café Tour
videos.overview: You hungry? Twyla takes us through a tour of Café Tropical’s ambitious menu.

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Vet Talk
videos.overview: Ted Mullens, Schitt’s Creek’s very own doctor to the dogs recaps some of the town’s more interesting pet mishaps.

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Social Media Guide
videos.overview: What's it like to lose all of your Instagram followers? To read about your demise via Twitter? Alexis and David share their revised feelings on social media.

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Community Service
videos.overview: We asked Mutt why he sold drugs and what he thinks of his new partner, Alexis Rose. He didn't have a lot to say.

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Worst Motel Ever
videos.overview: Sean and Bree have finally left the motel, so David and Stevie reflect with us on their visit.

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: The Birds and the Bees
videos.overview: David and Alexis go down memory lane on a less than erotic trip through their past sexual experiences.

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Oh Schitt!
videos.overview: Some behind the scenes fun from our documentation of the Roses in Schitt's Creek.

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: The Surprise Party
videos.overview: Jocelyn and David tell us what went into preparing Moira's surprise party and David tries to guess which 17 ingredients were in the punch.

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Goodbye
videos.overview: It's goodbye and good riddance Schitt’s Creek for David and Alexis. Some townsfolk share their memories of their time with the Rose family...

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Amish David
videos.overview: After being stranded on a farm for what feels like forever, David obviously knows everything about Amish culture and momentarily considers converting...

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Alexis’ Breakup Advice
videos.overview: When you've dated everyone from a bear - trapper to a South American drug lord, you're bound to know the best way to get rid of the guy whose air of mystery has been lost…

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Bob’s Garage
videos.overview: Welcome to Bob's Garage. Come on inside and let him show you where the magic happens... and no, we're not talking about that kind of magic. We're talking about the magic of fixing

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: The Gift
videos.overview: When you're born with a personal driver, a yacht, and a private plane, the word bicycle isn't even in your vocabulary. But it is the worst gift you could ever give Alexis...

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Customer Service
videos.overview: David might have gotten hired at the Blouse Barn, but complimenting customers and answering the phone is a skill he hasn't quite mastered...

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Ray’s House Tour
videos.overview: Have you ever caught yourself wondering how a realtor/photographer/travel agent lives? Haven't we all? Well, you're in luck 'cause Ray Butani gave us a glimpse of the good life.

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Picking Up
videos.overview: Who's got better game, David or Stevie? The friends with (sometimes) benefits share their favourite pick up lines.

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Ted’s Honeymoon
videos.overview: Couples massages, tandem bicycling, tango lessons... all romantic things you are sure to enjoy on your honeymoon... well, unless your fiancé leaves you before the wedding...

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Working Women
videos.overview: Alexis got a job. Obviously, she's now the reigning expert on women in the workforce. And she wants to turn the vet clinic into a nightclub...

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Parenting Advice
videos.overview: Hypothetically speaking, if David and Stevie were to have kids, how big of a disaster would it be? And most importantly, what would they name them?

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Apology Sausages
videos.overview: Some people apologize with roses, some say it with diamonds - but not the Schitts. Instead, Jocelyn says she's sorry... with sausages.

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Getting Legal
videos.overview: Who can tell the better lie? David and Alexis battle it out to see who's a worse person.

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Mutt’s New Girl
videos.overview: Alexis may have broken his heart, but Mutt's romantic side is still in one piece. And he even wrote a poem for his new girl, Tennessee.

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Fad Diets
videos.overview: Atkins, Paleo, Tae Bo, the Bowflex... we've heard all about the biggest diets and fitness fads. But what about the ones we haven't heard of?

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: The Threeway
videos.overview: Who's more adventurous when it comes to sex? David and Stevie talk it out and talk dirty.

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Workplace Etiquette
videos.overview: What's appropriate workplace etiquette when working with your ex fiancée? Ted and Alexis write the rules but obviously don't follow any of them.

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Motel For Sale
videos.overview: When Stevie very, very briefly thought of selling the motel, she looked into quotes, found a realtor, took some exterior photos, and even brainstormed a few infomercials...

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: The Jazzagals
videos.overview: Have you always wondered how Jocelyn came up with the name for The Jazzagals? Has the mystery kept you awake at night? Well the time has come...

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Party Planning
videos.overview: What does it take to throw the dopest murder mystery party that's ever gone down in the history of Schitt's Creek? Alexis Rose knows, obvi.

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Back to School
videos.overview: Alexis is back in high school and convinced that everyone sees her less as a student and more as a sexy TA. Jocelyn disagrees.

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Sex Talk
videos.overview: Who's more adventurous when it comes to sex, David or Stevie? The exes get up close and personal.

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Jocelyn’s Musical
videos.overview: Picture 'Hamilton', but totally different. Here's the sneak peek of Jocelyn's off-off-off-off Broadway musical you didn't know you needed in your life.

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: The Crew
videos.overview: There are SO many things to see and do in Schitt's Creek... except nothing actually right in the town, you'll likely have to venture a little bit outside...

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Teacher’s Review
videos.overview: What happens when you combine Jocelyn's boundless energy with a lice outbreak and a sex ed class? We're not exactly sure, but we'd love to find out.

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Alexis the Author
videos.overview: Could you ever picture Alexis Rose as a famous and reclusive best-selling author that lives in a log cabin in the woods? Us neither. But she can!

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Dream Jobs
videos.overview: Now that Alexis has graduated high school, what's her dream job? Who knows! But Ted's dreaming of hitting the devil sticking circuit... which is apparently a thing...

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Best Way to Die
videos.overview: When a man dies at the motel, David and Stevie get dark and twisty thinking about the best and worst ways to die.

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Nacho Chip Casserole
videos.overview: This is not your ordinary casserole. Jocelyn gives us more info on that nacho chip casserole she craves so much...

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: So High School
videos.overview: Twyla and Alexis obviously had wildly different high school experiences... but just how different you might ask?

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Dating with Alexis
videos.overview: When a date for Alexis consists of anything from a quick trip to the south of France to a day at the spa under the northern lights in Iceland, it's hard for her to offer advice...

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Mommy Blog
videos.overview: Jocelyn tries her hand at giving advice to new moms on her very first vlog. If you've never thought of using old jeans as a diaper, you're not alone.

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Improv
videos.overview: When you take a handful of improv classes and think you’re an acting coach. Twyla teaches Jocelyn the ropes. Yes, and...?

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Breakups
videos.overview: Some people handle breakups better than others... and then there's Stevie. She shows Patrick how to dump someone that you haven't even been on a date with. She's that good.

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Mr. and Mrs. Rose
videos.overview: If David and Stevie were forced to get married... well, let's just say they have wildly different ideas of what that would look like.

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Anatomy of the RomCom
videos.overview: The one where David tries to recreate scenes from his favourite romantic comedies and fails miserably.

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Puppy PSA
videos.overview: Alexis wants to include a pet adoption drive as part of Schitt's Creek Singles' Week. Could you give a home to one of these puppies?

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Alexis’ Awesome Icebreakers
videos.overview: With Singles' Week coming up, Alexis has been hard at work, even making a document to break the ice. Mutt answers the questionnaire.

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Meet the Puppies
videos.overview: The demand for dogs was so high after their successful puppy PSA, so Alexis and Ted get up close and personal with a few furry friends.

videos.title: Inside Schitt’s Creek: Holiday Traditions
videos.overview: Growing up, the Roses celebrated the holidays a little bit unconventionally. David and Patrick compare traditions.

videos.overview: After losing their fortune, the Rose family must relocate to their last remaining asset - a small town Johnny once bought as a joke.

videos.title: The Drip
videos.overview: Johnny must get permission to sell the town from its Mayor, Roland Schitt. David and Alexis spend a night out with the locals.

videos.title: Don't Worry, It's His Sister
videos.overview: Johnny tries to get a potentially offensive town sign taken down, while David is faced with the frightening task of finding a job.

videos.title: Bad Parents
videos.overview: Johnny and Moira, feeling like they have failed as parents, try to get to know their grown children. Alexis spies on Mutt and thinks he's having an affair with the Mayor's wife.

videos.title: The Cabin
videos.overview: Looking for privacy, Johnny and Moira take the Mayor up on his offer of using his cabin for a night, while Alexis and David use the opportunity to throw a party.

videos.title: Wine and Roses
videos.overview: Moira is hired to be a local winery's spokesperson;  David struggles with a health problem.

videos.title: Turkey Shoot
videos.overview: Following an incident where David is unable to kill an insect in his room, Stevie, as a joke, invites David along on Roland's annual turkey shoot.

videos.title: Allez Vous
videos.overview: Moira and David try to earn money by selling cosmetics to the locals, while Johnny heads to Elmdale in hopes of collecting unemployment insurance.

videos.title: Carl's Funeral
videos.overview: Johnny reluctantly agrees to speak at the funeral of a local man he doesn’t really know. Alexis struggles with her new boyfriend’s love of animals.

videos.title: Honeymoon
videos.overview: Johnny and Moira attend Roland’s annual Hawaiian bash. Alexis and Ted throw a couple’s dinner party, while David and Stevie’s relationship heats up.

videos.title: Little Sister
videos.overview: Moira's estranged sister, Deedee, pays an unexpected visit, while David agrees to talk with one of Jocelyn's students about being "different".

videos.title: Surprise Party
videos.overview: Johnny tries to arrange a surprise birthday party for Moira. Things backfire when Moira, unwittingly, takes over the planning of her own party.

videos.title: Town for Sale
videos.overview: Johnny finds a potential buyer for the town, while David and Alexis discover they may have become more attached to Schitt’s Creek than they ever thought possible.

videos.title: Finding David
videos.overview: The Roses search for their missing son, David, while Alexis takes her relationship with Mutt to the next level despite technically being engaged to Ted.

videos.title: Family Dinner
videos.overview: Moira decides to cook dinner with the help of David. Johnny scopes out an office for his consulting business. And Alexis finally comes clean with Ted about their engagement.

videos.title: Jazzagals
videos.overview: Moira attempts to join the town’s a cappella group. Alexis enjoys the heady first days of her latest relationship. And Johnny helps out at Bob’s Garage despite himself.

videos.title: Estate Sale
videos.overview: Johnny and Moira go to an estate sale. Mutt surprises Alexis with a bike, while Roland asks David to help him shop for a special item.

videos.title: Bob's Bagels
videos.overview: Johnny talks himself into an unlikely business partnership with Bob. David gets an interview at a woman's clothing store, while Moira reluctantly cares for an ailing Alexis.

videos.title: Moira vs. Town Council
videos.overview: Moira tries to beautify the town. David misuses the company credit card. A grooming misstep forces Alexis and Mutt to question their relationship.

videos.title: The Candidate
videos.overview: Johnny considers running for town council. David and Stevie look for love. Alexis copes with being single.

videos.title: Milk Money
videos.overview: Johnny gets thrown into the raw milk business. Moira tries to connect with the townspeople. David gives style advice.

videos.title: Moira's Nudes
videos.overview: Moira is worried that racy photos from her past will jeopardize the campaign; Johnny asks for financial help; Alexis gets a job.

videos.title: Ronnie's Party
videos.overview: Johnny and Moira meet with a key group of people, Alexis struggles with her new job, David offer's emotional support to his boss' daughter.

videos.title: The Motel Guest
videos.overview: Johnny and Moira have to deal with a surprise motel guest while Alexis and David go apartment hunting.

videos.title: Lawn Signs
videos.overview: Moira’s campaign takes a turn when some of her lawn signs mysteriously disappear. David and Alexis must work together to get David’s boss out of legal trouble.

videos.title: Happy Anniversary
videos.overview: Johnny and Moira go out for their anniversary and run into a couple they knew from their former life, while Alexis and David attend Mutt’s annual barn party, making up with some friends, and making out with others.

videos.title: Opening Night
videos.overview: Johnny struggles to find a new purpose, while Moira must confront the harsh realities of local politics.

videos.title: The Throuple
videos.overview: David and Stevie must come to terms with their new relationship, while Alexis and Moira become anxious when they schedule a rare mother/daughter lunch.

videos.title: New Car
videos.overview: Johnny and Moira try to get a deal on a used car while David helps Stevie put her great aunt to rest.

videos.title: Driving Test
videos.overview: Johnny and Moira worry about the future of the motel and David panics at the thought of retaking his driving test.

videos.title: Rooms by the Hour
videos.overview: Johnny puts the motel in jeopardy when he rents rooms to a dubious enterprise and David helps Moira with a film audition.

videos.title: Murder Mystery
videos.overview: Johnny and Stevie pitch a nearby golf course on a package deal with the motel. Moira tries to get out of an invitation to Twyla’s murder mystery party.

videos.title: General Store
videos.overview: David plans a new business venture, while Alexis adjusts to her first day at school.

videos.title: Motel Review
videos.overview: David meets a new friend while setting up his business, Johnny defends Alexis’s schoolwork, and Moira deals with a difficult guest at the motel.

videos.title: The Affair
videos.overview: Moira and Roland find themselves in a compromising situation. Alexis drives a wedge between David and Patrick.

videos.title: Sebastien Raine
videos.overview: David’s photographer ex-boyfriend arrives in town to do a photo series on Moira. Johnny and Roland suspect that Bob is cheating at poker.

videos.title: Stop Saying Lice!
videos.overview: Johnny tries to avoid the spread of lice in the motel. Moira tries to get out of having a flower garden named after her.

videos.title: Friends and Family
videos.overview: Johnny and Moira struggle to find a place for their family portrait. David hosts a 'soft launch' of his new store.

videos.title: Grad Night
videos.overview: Johnny and Stevie celebrate having a fully booked hotel; David and Patrick go on a date.

videos.title: Dead Guy in Room 4
videos.overview: While Moira fears she is responsible for the death of a motel guest, David and Patrick decide to make their budding romance official.

videos.title: Pregnancy Test
videos.overview: Johnny braces himself for the possibility of another baby in the family after finding a positive pregnancy test and David and Patrick search for privacy.

videos.title: Asbestos Fest
videos.overview: Moira prepares for her headline debut at the annual Schitt's Creek Asbestos Fest, while David deals with a group of loitering teens in the apothecary.

videos.title: Girls' Night
videos.overview: Alexis and Twyla have a girls' night out and Patrick teaches David about compromise.

videos.title: RIP Moira Rose
videos.overview: A rumor of Moira's death appears online and Roland asks Johnny to be his child's godfather.

videos.title: Open Mic
videos.overview: David and Patrick host an open mic night; Johnny and Stevie start rebranding the hotel.

videos.title: The Barbecue
videos.overview: David and Moira hold a party for Patrick, but David worries about how his family would adversely affect Patrick. Alexis investigates with help a mysterious text from Ted.

videos.title: The Jazzaguy
videos.overview: After the barbecue fiasco, Stevie takes David to a spa for some consoling, but she bought a honeymoon package making things worse. Johnny impresses the Jazzagals with his talents, but Moira doesn't like his joining the group. Alexis tries out a dating app and dates a cute local.

videos.title: The Olive Branch
videos.overview: David tries to reconcile with Patrick. Moira pitches a singles event at Town Hall while Johnny buys Stevie a gift for her help at the motel.

videos.title: Baby Sprinkle
videos.overview: For research, Johnny and Moira attend a singles event but get too involved. Alexis runs into an old friend, David agrees to help Jocelyn in planning her baby shower.

videos.title: The Rollout
videos.overview: Moira tries to avoid jury duty and David issues a recall on a Rose Apothecary product that causes rashes.

videos.title: Singles Week
videos.overview: Singles Week gets underway just as Jocelyn’s baby arrives, and Patrick takes his relationship with David to the next level.

videos.title: The Crowening
videos.overview: While Moira is in Bosnia filming the Crows movie that she hopes will revive her acting career, David attempts to take his relationship with Patrick to new heights.

videos.title: Love Letters
videos.overview: A sleep-deprived Moira worries about a stack of old love letters addressed to Johnny from another woman, while David and Stevie are held up at David's store.

videos.title: The Plant
videos.overview: Alexis and Johnny hatch a plan to impress a motel reviewer, while David and Patrick search for a new apartment.

videos.title: The Dress
videos.overview: Johnny finds himself under financial pressure with the arrival of Moira’s high-priced red carpet gown for the Crows movie premiere. David is conned into taking a road trip with Stevie.

videos.title: Housewarming
videos.overview: David and Patrick throw a housewarming party and Ted finally lets loose, while Johnny and Moira try their best to babysit Roland Jr. for the evening.

videos.title: Rock On!
videos.overview: Moira and the Jazzagals take Jocelyn out for a night at the casino, while Johnny tries to navigate an awkward conversation with Stevie about intimacy in the workplace.

videos.title: A Whisper of Desire
videos.overview: Johnny suspects that Ted’s mom is attracted to him, while Moira can’t resist getting involved in a local musical production.

videos.title: The Hospies
videos.overview: Johnny and Stevie attend the regional hospitality awards, while Moira does everything in her power to stop Alexis from auditioning for Cabaret.

videos.title: The M.V.P.
videos.overview: David agrees to sub in for the annual baseball game, and Moira runs a rehearsal that pushes Stevie over the edge.

videos.title: Roadkill
videos.overview: Johnny and Moira’s afternoon plans are interrupted when they accidentally hit a cat. David runs into an old colleague at the flea market whose new business bears a striking resemblance to Rose Apothecary.

videos.title: Meet the Parents
videos.overview: Patrick’s parents are in town for his surprise party, but the parents end up with an even bigger surprise, while Alexis drags Moira to a soap opera convention.

videos.title: The Roast
videos.overview: Johnny fills in for Moira at the annual Mayor’s Roast, as David distracts Moira from finding out that Stevie and Patrick have been taking private dance lessons.

videos.title: The Hike
videos.overview: Patrick tries to take David on a romantic hike, while Johnny has a health scare that sends everyone into a panic.

videos.title: Life Is a Cabaret
videos.overview: It’s Opening Night for Cabaret,and Stevie is nowhere to be found. David tries to make a big announcement, but keeps getting overshadowed by the musical.

videos.title: Smoke Signals
videos.overview: David scouts a potential wedding venue, while Johnny and Moira have a romantic picnic by the creek.

videos.title: The Incident
videos.overview: David is embarrassed by a childhood issue that resurfaces, and only spirals further when Patrick is so understanding. Johnny, Stevie and Roland attend a viewing for a nearby motel. Alexis helps Moira join social media.

videos.title: The Job Interview
videos.overview: Johnny and Moira endeavor to secure an investor for a new motel while Alexis and Ted struggle with long-distance.

videos.title: Maid of Honour
videos.overview: Moira shares the newly released “Crows” movie trailer with the Jazzagals. Johnny and Roland find a suspicious bag of money at the new motel.

videos.title: The Premiere
videos.overview: Alexis plans a local premiere for the "Crows" movie, and Moira makes a big splash on the red carpet. David tends to Patrick after his wisdom teeth removal.

videos.title: The Wingman
videos.overview: Alexis and Moira deal with the aftermath of a viral video, while Johnny helps Bob get back out in the dating world.

videos.title: Moira Rosé
videos.overview: Moira and David sample wine at Herb Ertlinger's vineyard, while Johnny attempts to have “the talk” with Patrick.

videos.title: The Presidential Suite
videos.overview: Johnny and Moira spend a night at the presidential suite in the new motel, while Alexis receives a surprise visitor.

videos.title: Rebound
videos.overview: Johnny becomes overly involved in Alexis' romantic life, while Moira offends the townspeople in an interview with People magazine.

videos.title: Sunrise, Sunset
videos.overview: Moira’s former "Sunrise Bay" producers show up with big news, while Alexis binge-watches old episodes of the soap and discovers some dirt.

videos.overview: The Roses attend the Escape Room portion of David and Patrick's Bachelor Party, but their participation wanes the more their personal dilemmas come to a head.

videos.overview: Johnny, Stevie and Roland head to New York for their pitch meeting, while the family anxiously awaits their return.
